title: Project-Regon⛰️
description: An advanced vanilla-style world generator that transforms the Overworld into a dramatic but realistic landscape filled with huge formations, unique terrain shapes, and natural-looking environments, making every seed and every location feel perfect.
body:
![Project-Regon main image.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/997ae9eb77cbcfdb87dff69992e1652feb8a8d67_0.webp)

## Introduction to the datapack
This datapack creates a **more realistic and exploration-focused Overworld,** with special attention to **hills, slopes, and connected terrain.** Hills are shaped to feel like real landforms, with slopes, ridges, valleys, and natural paths between high areas. The terrain forms walkable ridges, saddles, or slopes between those hills.

### ✨Main Features
- Adds **errosion.**
- Adds **errosion noise.**
- Generates **hydraulic terrain.**
- **More terrain features** like:
  - mountain ranges
  - valleys
  - cliffs
  - plateaus
  - underground rivers
  - **new combined** realistic looking terrain shapes
- More variation, so every world and every place feels different and perfect.
- Deeper oceans, larger landmasses, and overall **a more realistic world structure.**
- Improves **natural terrain flow** between hills, mountains, valleys, plains, savanna biomes and **all other minecraft biomes.**
- Generates **more mountain rings.**
- Generates more natural and realistic terrain **instead of overly smoothed landscapes like other world generation mods or datapacks.**

![Underground river generated with Project-Regon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d04bffc4de0f4b8614c64c07495795d310b28811_0.webp)

### 🛠️How it works:


**Minecraft Perlin Noise:**

```
small hills → normal rivers → normal mountains → normal oceans
```


**Project-Regon World Generator:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

```
continents → huge mountain systems → deeper oceans → valleys → plateaus → underground rivers
```

</details>

![A mountain with hydraulic erosion layers visible. Generated with Project-Regon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/934bb8f14a38a6aabe4aa469015db879b2780f1c_0.webp)

![Example terrain generated with Project-Regon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32c8ba193ff3279c4784db4da5786530d99d3a27_0.webp)

### 💡Informations:

The terrain is also inspired by real landscapes and erosion-shaped environments. Softer terrain such as sand can appear more naturally worn down or shaped compared to harder stone areas.
Hills, cliffs, valleys, and large formations make the world more interesting, but still playable. Instead, you can look at the terrain, find a natural way up, and choose your path. Unlike some terrain generators that make everything overly smooth, this datapack keeps the terrain natural and varied.
